channel.title: Z3X-1337 — Security Engineering Notes
channel.description: Evidence-first public security engineering notes by Zaid Hijazi.

item.title: Security headers are control surfaces.
item.description: A practical note on reviewing HTTP security headers as route-specific controls rather than a pass/fail checklist.

item.title: Authorization is a server-side decision.
item.description: A concise note on why authorization decisions belong on the service that owns the protected action or resource.

item.title: Authentication telemetry needs context.
item.description: Repeated authentication failures are useful review signals, not standalone verdicts.

item.title: IOC provenance is part of the finding.
item.description: Keep an indicator’s raw source, normalized form, transformation, and limitations in the same reviewable record.
